The `pin` element has `position: absolute` with `top: 10px, left: 10px`. Currently, with `root>plain` not being positioned, `pin`'s containing block is the nearest positioned ancestor, which is `root` (at 0,0). After adding `position: relative` to `root>plain` (at 20,20), `pin` will be positioned relative to `root>plain` instead, so its top-left moves to 20+10, 20+10.

ANSWER: 30,30
